description: Produces a compact KPI digest showing how key metrics changed over a period and what's driving the movement. Use this skill when someone asks for a performance summary, a weekly recap, a morning briefing, a KPI update, or any variation of "how did we do this week/month." Also trigger for "give me a performance overview," "what moved in the last 7 days," "pull our AA KPI report," or "summarize our metrics."
